scope: Compute lexical cosine scores from raw document lines, retrieve top-k, gate, extract a matching fact quote, verify its retrieved source span, refuse unsupported/conflicting evidence, and evaluate separately annotated retrieval cases. No learned generation, embedding service, semantic entailment or production RAG claim.
question_form: What is [the] <attribute> for <entity>? (case-insensitive; optional question mark; single identifier entity)
citation_offsets: Zero-based Python Unicode character offsets: start inclusive, end exclusive, into the unchanged document text.

metrics.recall_at_k: Unique labeled relevant chunk IDs found in retrieved top-k / all labeled relevant IDs; null when no relevant IDs. Assessment labels are never passed to answer().
metrics.exact_support_rate: Candidate quotes passing retrieved-context, source-span, exact-text and question-target checks / candidate quotes; null when no candidates. Not semantic faithfulness or factual truth.

cases.question: What is the retention period for Atlas?
What is the retention period for Beacon?
What is the storage region for Atlas?
What is the trading fee for Atlas?
What is the retention period for Nimbus?

limitations: a threshold is not an answerability proof
no authentication, access-control, provider, neural model, live trading or production deployment
